name: bi-delivery
description: Domain-agnostic multi-stage Antigravity Power BI engineering workflow orchestrating G0 data profiling/reconciliation, G1 design validation, optional semantic model & PBIR delivery, parallel specialist hygiene/governance audits, and G0-G7 evidence-gated release.

requirement_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the requirement YAML contract.

project_dir.description: Optional override for target PBIP project directory (defaults to requirement contract project.pbip_path / target_pbip).

raw_data_dir.description: Optional raw flat-file directory override for Gate G0 profiling.

offline.description: Run offline-only verification gates when live Desktop is unavailable.

mode.description: deliver runs end-to-end data/model/report authoring + G0-G7 verification; audit runs G0, G1 + parallel specialist audits without mutating artifacts.

auto_commit.description: When mode=deliver and all 8 gates pass, run bi-agent git-commit.

allow_main.description: Allow committing directly on main/master when auto_commit is true.
